styles.name: warm label print
styles.why: High-contrast display serif for labels and prices, a deep warm brown accent and solid surfaces feel like a printed product label; suits food and drink boxes.

styles.name: playful bright
styles.why: For beauty, snack, toy and pet boxes with a younger audience.

styles.name: calm curated
styles.why: For book and lifestyle clubs where the curation is the product.

pitfalls: Recurring charge not stated clearly before payment (amount, frequency, first charge date, how to cancel) — a legal requirement for subscriptions in many markets.
Cancelling made harder than subscribing; offer online cancel and say so on the plans page.
Only the per-delivery price shown; show per-unit and per-month too so plans compare honestly.
Price grid cells that are not keyboard-operable or not announced with their row and column.
Current edition section left stale after the cycle changes.
Gift subscriptions that renew automatically without the buyer knowing.
Next delivery dates computed in the visitor's time zone instead of the warehouse's.
